module.name: axm-invariant-lab
module.purpose: Bounded state-space exploration, cross-implementation checking, and counterexample evidence for explicitly modeled AXM invariants.

capabilities.description: Explore a finite, explicitly declared transition model breadth-first to find shortest invariant counterexamples or preserve unknown observations as HOLD.

evidence.boundary: second implementation shares the authored model transition and invariant functions; model fidelity is not independently proven

capabilities.description: Cross-check the primary visited-state explorer with an independent bounded path enumerator and fail closed when the reference enumeration budget is incomplete.
Emit bounded machine-readable FAIL/HOLD evidence without granting donor, execution, merge, promotion, or CANON authority.

truth_boundary: A PASS means no counterexample was found only inside the exact declared model, predicates, transitions, and bound. Cross-implementation agreement checks exploration semantics over shared authored model functions; it does not independently prove model fidelity, donor code, cross-repo adoption, or the real world. This module grants no execution, merge, promotion, device, network, or CANON authority.
